scope: Four generic Builder.Many derived instances with arbitrary element dictionaries

instances.support: Seq cached length guard, element == only; caller == or /= MINIMAL defaults
Seq lexicographic compare; GHC relational defaults and caller compare or <= MINIMAL; no element dictionary laws assumed
record constructor precedence, Seq fromList, element showList, lazy String/ShowS, caller show or showsPrec MINIMAL
GHC ReadP/ReadPrec Get/Look/Fail/Result/Final, context/reset, ordered duplicate alternatives, caller readsPrec or readPrec MINIMAL plus independent list overrides

source_protocol: Shared root/field thunks and explicit lazy GenericList/ManyReadInput represent source WHNF. ReadS alternatives/remainders retain order and multiplicity. Whole read only demands uniqueness, never materializes all parses.
finite_bridges: String/CharacterString and typed Int/Char adapters are finite conveniences; no claim that JVM strict callback signatures express arbitrary Haskell bottom arguments.
limits: General GHC heap graphs, async exceptions and cyclic missing-MINIMAL defaults are not emulated
ReadS full materialization and Haskell String conversion remain bounded by JVM memory; source lazy prefix APIs are provided
Instrumented native sharing observations are tied to the recorded optimized compiler profile, not universal unsafePerformIO equivalence
